About

01 — PROFILE

I'm Omar Osama, a Media & Graphic Designer and digital creator based in Cairo, Egypt. I create visual identities and digital experiences across brand identity, logo design, social media, product photography, and web design & development.

My work is driven by a simple idea: design should communicate before it decorates. I focus on building clear visual systems, thoughtful compositions, and consistent experiences that give every project a distinct identity.

Alongside my creative work, I'm continuously learning and experimenting with new design tools, digital technologies, and creative approaches — turning ideas into work that is purposeful, modern, and visually considered.

Frequently asked questions

04 — QUESTIONS
01What design services do you offer?+

I offer a focused range of creative services, including Logo Design & Brand Identity, Social Media Design, Product Photography & Visual Showcases, and Website Design & Development. Each service can be tailored to the specific needs and goals of the project.

02How do I start a project with you?+

Simply get in touch through the Contact section and tell me about your project, what you need, and your goals. I'll review the brief and discuss the next steps with you.

03What information do you need before starting a project?+

A clear project brief is the best starting point. Depending on the service, this may include your brand name, target audience, preferred style, references, content, required deliverables, and any specific requirements.

04Do you create complete brand identities or only logos?+

Both. I can create a standalone logo or develop a more complete brand identity system, including the visual direction, typography, colors, logo variations, and supporting brand elements.

05Can you design social media posts and covers for my brand?+

Yes. I create social media posts, covers, and other visual content designed to maintain a consistent and professional visual identity across your platforms.

06Do you offer product photography and product showcases?+

Yes. I provide product photography and visual product showcases, focusing on clean composition, presentation, lighting, and visuals that make the product stand out.

07Do you design and develop websites?+

Yes. I work on both website design and front-end development, combining visual design with technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create modern digital experiences.

08How long does a project take?+

Project timelines depend on the type, scope, number of deliverables, and revisions required. Once I understand the project requirements, I can provide a more accurate estimated timeline.
